audit_items.title: Does set_code trigger empty account destruction when appropriate?
audit_items.rationale: EIP-7702 set_code is an execution layer operation (account state management). Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not implement execution layer account state transitions. This functionality would be in execution clients like Geth, Erigon, or Reth.

code_scope.reason: Component mismatch: execution layer operation in consensus layer client

audit_items.audit_notes: Source: PROP-0047. Trust boundary: tb-003. Severity: Medium. This is an EL specification requirement not applicable to CL clients.

audit_items.title: Does EIP-155 signing hash include (chain_id, 0, 0) padding?
audit_items.rationale: EIP-155 transaction signing is an execution layer operation. Prysm is a consensus layer client and does not sign or validate execution layer transactions. This is handled by execution clients.

code_scope.reason: Component mismatch: execution layer transaction signing in consensus layer client

audit_items.audit_notes: Source: PROP-0048. Trust boundary: tb-009. Severity: High. EIP-155 is an EL transaction format not implemented in CL clients.

audit_items.title: Does bytes_to_bls_field reject values >= BLS_MODULUS?
audit_items.rationale: bytes_to_bls_field is a low-level cryptographic primitive implemented in external KZG libraries (c-kzg-4844), not in Prysm's Go codebase. Prysm uses the go-kzg-4844 bindings which wrap the C library. The validation logic is in the external dependency, not auditable in Prysm's source.

code_scope.reason: External dependency: implemented in c-kzg-4844 library, not in Prysm codebase

audit_items.audit_notes: Source: PROP-W3B4-1. Trust boundary: tb-001. Severity: Critical. This function is in the c-kzg-4844 library used by all Ethereum consensus clients.

audit_items.title: Are cell_to_coset_evals and coset_evals_to_cell exact inverses?
audit_items.rationale: cell_to_coset_evals and coset_evals_to_cell are cryptographic primitives implemented in the c-kzg-4844 external library, not in Prysm's Go codebase. These functions are part of the KZG polynomial commitment scheme implementation maintained separately from Prysm.

code_scope.reason: External dependency: implemented in c-kzg-4844 library

audit_items.audit_notes: Source: PROP-W3B4-2. Trust boundary: tb-002. Severity: Critical. FFT operations are in external cryptographic library.

audit_items.title: Does cell_to_coset_evals output exactly FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL elements?
audit_items.rationale: cell_to_coset_evals is implemented in the c-kzg-4844 external library. The output size validation is part of the cryptographic library implementation, not Prysm's Go code.

code_scope.reason: External dependency: implemented in c-kzg-4844 library

audit_items.audit_notes: Source: PROP-W3B4-3. Trust boundary: tb-002. Severity: High. Size validation is in external KZG library.

audit_items.title: Does _fft_field reject non-power-of-2 input lengths?
audit_items.rationale: _fft_field is an internal FFT implementation function in the c-kzg-4844 library. This is a low-level cryptographic primitive not exposed in Prysm's codebase. Input validation occurs within the external library.

code_scope.reason: External dependency: internal function in c-kzg-4844 library

audit_items.audit_notes: Source: PROP-W3B4-5. Trust boundary: tb-002. Severity: High. FFT implementation is in external library.

audit_items.title: Does inverse FFT apply 1/N normalization factor?
audit_items.rationale: Inverse FFT normalization is implemented in the c-kzg-4844 library's FFT routines. This is a mathematical property of the cryptographic library implementation, not auditable in Prysm's source code.

code_scope.reason: External dependency: FFT implementation in c-kzg-4844 library

audit_items.audit_notes: Source: PROP-W3B4-7. Trust boundary: tb-003. Severity: Critical. FFT normalization is handled by external cryptographic library.

audit_items.title: Does coset FFT use non-intersecting evaluation domain?
audit_items.rationale: Coset FFT domain construction and PRIMITIVE_ROOT_OF_UNITY selection are implemented in the c-kzg-4844 library. The mathematical correctness of domain separation is a property of the external cryptographic implementation.

code_scope.reason: External dependency: domain construction in c-kzg-4844 library

audit_items.audit_notes: Source: PROP-W3B4-8. Trust boundaries: tb-008, tb-009. Severity: Critical. Domain construction is in external library.

audit_items.title: Does Fiat-Shamir challenge include ALL verifier-relevant data?
audit_items.rationale: Fiat-Shamir challenge computation for KZG batch verification is implemented in the c-kzg-4844 library. The hash input construction is part of the cryptographic library, not Prysm's codebase. Prysm calls the library's verification functions but doesn't implement the challenge generation logic.

code_scope.reason: External dependency: Fiat-Shamir implementation in c-kzg-4844 library

audit_items.audit_notes: Source: PROP-W3B4-9. Trust boundary: tb-006. Severity: Critical. Challenge generation is in external KZG library.

audit_items.title: Is RANDOM_CHALLENGE_KZG_CELL_BATCH_DOMAIN globally unique?
audit_items.rationale: RANDOM_CHALLENGE_KZG_CELL_BATCH_DOMAIN is a constant defined in the Ethereum consensus specification and implemented in the c-kzg-4844 library. While Prysm may reference this constant indirectly through library calls, the domain separator value itself is defined by the protocol specification and library implementation, not in Prysm's code. Uniqueness is a specification-level property.

code_scope.reason: Protocol constant defined in consensus spec and implemented in c-kzg-4844 library

audit_items.audit_notes: Source: PROP-W3B4-10. Trust boundary: tb-006. Severity: High. Domain separator is a specification constant in external library.
